description: Unit test class for the SubjectDeleted event in the org.eclipse.ditto.signals.events.policies package. It tests immutability, equality, serialization/deserialization, and constructor validation for the SubjectDeleted class.

classes.name: SubjectDeletedTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for SubjectDeleted event, testing immutability, equality, JSON serialization/deserialization, and constructor validation.

methods.name: assertImmutability
methods.description: Tests that instances of SubjectDeleted are immutable and that SubjectId and Label are also immutable.

methods.name: testHashCodeAndEquals
methods.description: Verifies the correctness of equals() and hashCode() implementations for SubjectDeleted.

methods.name: tryToCreateInstanceWithNullPolicyIdString
methods.description: Ensures that creating a SubjectDeleted with a null policy ID string throws PolicyIdInvalidException.

methods.name: tryToCreateInstanceWithNullPolicyId
methods.description: Ensures that creating a SubjectDeleted with null PolicyId throws NullPointerException.

methods.name: tryToCreateInstanceWithNullLabel
methods.description: Ensures that creating a SubjectDeleted with null label throws NullPointerException.

methods.name: tryToCreateInstanceWithNullSubject
methods.description: Ensures that creating a SubjectDeleted with null subject ID throws NullPointerException.

methods.name: toJsonReturnsExpected
methods.description: Checks that the toJson() method produces the expected JSON representation of the SubjectDeleted instance.

methods.name: createInstanceFromValidJson
methods.description: Tests that a SubjectDeleted instance can be correctly created from valid JSON.
